108-T11A.statement_en: Multiple reports identify al-As ibn Wa'il as the hostile referent.
qualifications: The Mujahid evidence unit remains compound with two outer branches converging at Ibn Abi Najih.
The second Qatada report retains بلغنا and is not upgraded to eyewitness testimony.
The preceding report [277,398) says 'your enemy' without naming al-As in its report text and is excluded.
The Ibn Zayd report [1485,1680) describes an unnamed man and is excluded.

108-T11C.statement_en: Two reports connect the verse with Quraysh speakers who disparaged Muhammad during the Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf episode; they do not simply identify Ka'b himself as the hostile referent.

excluded_span.reason: Intervening Ikrima report lacks the explicit Ka'b episode.

qualifications: Ikrima and Ibn Abbas are report authorities; the Meccan speakers and Ka'b remain narrative participants.
The first report distinguishes the cited Ka'b passage from 108:3 applied to those who spoke disparagingly about Muhammad.
The second report retains the speakers' question, Ka'b's answer, and its two Quranic associations.
The two routes share Ikrima naming; independence and authenticity remain unassessed.

explicit_disagreements_and_absences: T11A al-As, T11B Uqba, T11C Quraysh speakers in the Ka'b episode, and T11D universal application remain separate positions.
T11C does not simply identify Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf as the hostile referent.
All T11A/T11C English statements are controlled research translations; no stored English witness is present.
No route independence, authentication, physical identity, database persistence, publication readiness, or Tabari exclusivity is inferred.
